Metadata.description: A production-ready Next.js 16 + Payload 3 starter on Postgres, wired for AI-assisted development with Cursor and Claude Code.

Home.title: Ship your SaaS this weekend, not next quarter.
Home.note: Early access updates only. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.
Home.featuresTitle: Everything a solo founder needs on day one

admin.title: Content & admin in one app
admin.body: Payload 3 runs inside Next.js: collections, auth, uploads and a full admin panel at /admin — no second service to deploy.

postgres.title: Postgres that scales to zero
postgres.body: Neon in production, plain Postgres locally. Schema changes go through versioned Payload migrations, applied on every Vercel deploy.

types.title: Type-safe end to end
types.body: Generated Payload types, Zod at every boundary, Server Actions instead of hand-written API routes.

tests.title: Tests the agent can run
tests.body: Vitest for logic and the Payload Local API, Playwright for real user flows. One command tells the agent whether it is done.

ai.title: AI workflow built in
ai.body: AGENTS.md, scoped Cursor rules, skills, subagents and hooks — shared by Cursor and Claude Code from the same files.

css.title: Plain CSS Modules
css.body: Design tokens as CSS variables, dark mode via prefers-color-scheme, zero runtime styling cost.
